subject: POC runway: org setup, API key rotation, IP allowlist & VPC peering
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Alex Burns <alex@medixcorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 3 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC runway: org setup, API key rotation, IP allowlist & VPC peering

Alex —

Great to meet you last week. Per our MAP conversation I pulled together a concise access + networking runway so we can get your evaluation cluster green by the target close date. Things that need explicit confirmation from your side are bolded below.

High-level asks (MAP items):
- Org + billing: create a dedicated MedixCorp org folder /proj/redwood-eval (we'll provide the onboarding ticket template).
- API keys: one short-lived eval key per test team; we recommend automatic rotation after 30 days.
- IP allowlist: provide source CIDR(s) for allowlist to our gateway and peering endpoints.
- VPC peering: originate peering from MedixCorp; we need the proposed peering CIDR and preferred maintenance window.

Proposed schedule (target close = Aug 29):
- Aug 4: org & IAM preflight (your admin + our onboarding SE)
- Aug 6-8: API key issuance + basic smoke tests
- Aug 11: IP allowlist confirmed by security + VPC peering request submitted
- Aug 13-15: peering activation & end-to-end validation

Please confirm: the maintenance window preferred for VPC peering (overnight PST or weekend?), and the CIDRs your networking team will present. Also confirm whether MedixCorp requires HSM-backed keys for this eval or standard KMS keys will suffice.

Attachments: MAP-v0.1.pdf (MAP checklist), redwood-network-diagram.png (peering endpoints & required routes)

Thanks — we want to keep this lightweight and predictable. If that schedule works I'll lock the calendar and open the onboarding ticket.

—Grace
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Alex Burns <alex@medixcorp.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: MedixCorp Security <security@medixcorp.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC runway: org setup, API key rotation, IP allowlist & VPC peering

Grace —

Thanks for the clear plan. A few items from security/networking:
- Maintenance window: prefer weekend maintenance (Sat 0200-0500 UTC) for peering activation.
- CIDR: we'll supply two /28 ranges for the endpoints (will send exact values after internal review).
- Keys: Security prefers HSM-backed keys even for evals, but we can accept standard KMS if HSM introduces a week+ delay.

Can you confirm whether Redwood supports route filters on the peering side (we need to limit advertised prefixes) and whether the peering will be active only for the eval org?

I'll loop in our infra lead with exact CIDRs by EOD Tue.

—Alex
Alex Burns
Sr. Product Manager, MedixCorp
alex@medixcorp.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Aug 2025 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC runway: org setup, API key rotation, IP allowlist & VPC peering

Folks —

Small operational notes to keep the timeline tight:
1) Sequence: org/IAM -> API keys -> allowlist -> peering -> smoke test. Keep peering last to avoid partial routability.
2) API keys: we'll create namespaced keys so Medix teams can differentiate: REDWOOD_EVAL_<team>-<env>-<date>. Example: REDWOOD_EVAL_ingest-QA-0806. Keys will be issued with scoped perms (generate:read only).
3) Peering: Redwood supports route filters on our side; we can accept up to 10 advertised prefixes per peer and limit to the eval org only.
4) Runbook: I'll open internal ticket NET-827 and a public MAP checklist doc for Alex to review.

Action items I can pick up: open NET-827, create the initial API keys, and schedule the peering window for Aug 14 (backup weekend Aug 16). Grace — please confirm with Alex on the weekend preference.

Attachments: redwood-network-diagram.png

—Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Alex Burns <alex@medixcorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 6 Aug 2025 15:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC runway: org setup, API key rotation, IP allowlist & VPC peering

Alex —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming items and next steps below so we have a single source of truth for the MAP: 

Confirmed items:
- Maintenance window: target weekend Aug 14 (Sat) 02:00–05:00 UTC; backup Aug 16 (Mon overnight) if your infra team flags any constraints.
- Redwood supports route filters and will restrict advertisement to the eval org only.
- HSM keys: we can provision KMS keys immediately; HSM-backed requires a lead time ~6 business days. If you'd like HSM, please confirm ASAP and we'll queue it.

What we need from MedixCorp by Tue EOD (Aug 12):
- Final CIDR(s) for allowlist (two /28s)
- Decision: HSM (yes/no) for API keys
- Primary contact for peering cutover (name + mobile)

I'll:
- Open engineering ticket NET-827 (Ben) for peering work and post the runbook there.
- Create initial scoped API keys and share them through the secure channel once you confirm KMS vs HSM.
- Send updated MAP PDF with concrete dates and acceptance criteria (attached).

If that all looks good I'm going to lock the calendar and create the HubSpot MAP record (DEAL-4391). Please reply with the CIDRs and HSM decision and we'll proceed.

Attachments: MAP-v0.1.pdf (updated with dates), redwood-network-diagram.png

—Grace
